title: "Table cells with escaped pipes"

# Table cells with escaped pipes

A GFM cell splits on an unescaped pipe wherever it appears, so a pipe inside a
cell's code span is written `\|` in the source.

| Flag                            | Effect                        |
| ------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `--output-format <json\|text>`  | Explicit format selection     |
| `--color <auto\|always\|never>` | Colorize output               |
| `enum=fast\|thorough`           | Allowed values                |

Prose after the table.
